## What changed

Describe the user or maintainer outcome. Link the issue or design decision when
one exists.

## Verification

List the exact commands or manual checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] New behavior has tests at the narrowest useful boundary.
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy`, and relevant Rust tests pass.
- [ ] Web typecheck, lint, build, and relevant tests pass when the UI changes.
- [ ] Public behavior, operator contracts, or release notes are documented.
- [ ] No secrets, private datasets, generated build output, or local paths are included.
